recipes.title: Lemon Cottage Cheese Cheesecake Cup

items.i: sweetener, to taste (optional — e.g. monk fruit drops)

steps: Blend the cottage cheese, lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla, salt and sweetener until completely smooth.
Pour into a bowl or glass.
Crush the graham crackers in a bag and scatter over the top.
Eat straight away, or chill for a thicker texture.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros (per serve) come from the video description (original recipe by @madelainerascan). The description says zest of a lemon; the video uses half.
